study.title: Fixed initial fraction .5: all CST field LR multipliers16/32/64/128
study.status_note: All5 unique arms completed at976updates plus a repeated Dense control;12 final/prefix checkpoints audited and8 observer net-change frames independently reproduced. Best of four CST rates=32x, DEV CE3.432772, Dense3.308982, gap0.123791. One seed, no RMS calibration/confirmation/default adoption.

recovery.scope: 128x CLI admission recovery; no prior128x training; same initialization/data/budget, fresh Dense; preserve original CLI failure

metrics.scope: One development seed, fixed all-CST-field LR family; no optimality or convergence claim

fraction_motion.scope: Equal Atom counts per site. Means/RMS aggregate all Atoms; path statistics reduce every per-Atom update, full individual trajectories are not saved. Algebraic radius components do not identify causal training effects.
